title: Wiki-Talkie: Multilingual Benchmarking of Persona-Based Agents on Real-World Discussions

paragraphs.en: LLMs are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in social environments, making it critical to study their ability to faithfully simulate human interactions. Central to this is grounding agents in realistic user personas, yet existing datasets rely on fictional personas and are limited to a handful of languages, lacking the empirical grounding necessary to evaluate behavioral fidelity across diverse populations. We introduce Wiki-Talkie, a multilingual dataset of real-world conversations from Wikipedia Talk pages across five languages spanning two language families: Germanic (German, English) and Romance (Spanish, French, Italian), paired with personas derived from real user communities and encompassing sociodemographic attributes, self-descriptions, and behaviorally grounded interaction traits. Using Wiki-Talkie, we evaluate agent interactional behavior on a next-turn generation task across various persona conditioning strategies. Our evaluation assesses whether agents collectively reproduce the distributional behavioral patterns observed in human discussions. Results show that user’s comment history exemplifying interaction behavior consistently outperforms explicit persona information. In addition, models systematically underproduce negative or extreme sentiments, while over producing references and suggestions, revealing biases toward agreeableness and positivity. Crucially, these patterns hold robustly across languages, with small cross-lingual differences. 1 1 1 Code and data are available at https://github.com/amazon-science/wikitalkie .

paragraphs.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly embedded in real-world social systems, from community moderation on Reddit 2 2 2 https://redditinc.com/news/oterlu-team-joins-reddit-to-accelerate-safety-efforts . to experimental platforms like MoltBook 3 3 3 https://www.moltbook.com . where LLMs autonomously interact at scale. These developments position LLMs not merely as tools, but as agents : autonomous actors participating in governance, culture, and social interaction. Central to the design of such agents is the role they are asked to play ( Shanahan et al., 2023 ; Tseng et al., 2024 ) , e.g. the persona , that is, a composite of individual traits such as background facts, language behavior, and interaction style ( Liu et al., 2025a ) . This approach has been shown to improve alignment with real human populations in applications such as personalized dialogues ( Liu et al., 2025a ) , linguistic annotation ( Orlikowski et al., 2025 ) , and social simulations ( Argyle et al., 2023 ; Park et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地嵌入到现实世界的社会系统中，从 Reddit 上的社区内容管理 2 2 2 https://redditinc.com/news/oterlu-team-joins-reddit-to-accelerate-safety-efforts ，到像 MoltBook 3 3 3 https://www.moltbook.com 这样的实验性平台，在这些平台上，LLM 能够自主地进行大规模互动。 这些发展使 LLM 不再仅仅是工具，而是作为智能体——即参与治理、文化和社交互动的自主行动者。 这类智能体设计的核心在于其被赋予的角色（Shanahan et al., 2023; Tseng et al., 2024），例如“人格设定”，即由背景事实、语言行为和互动风格等个体特征组成的综合体（Liu et al., 2025a）。 研究表明，这种方法能够提升智能体在个性化对话（Liu et al., 2025a）、语言标注（Orlikowski et al., 2025）和社会模拟（Argyle et al., 2023; Park et al., 2024）等应用中与真实人类群体的契合度。

paragraphs.en: However, existing datasets for modeling persona-based conversational agents rely on fictional personas ( Smith et al., 2020 ; Jang et al., 2022 ; Xu et al., 2022a ; Xu et al., 2022b ; Yamashita et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Lotfi et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2022 ; Occhipinti et al., 2024 ) , making it impossible to verify whether agent behavior faithfully reflects the opinions, linguistic patterns, and interaction dynamics of the actual human population being simulated. Datasets extracting personas from large-scale media ( Zheng et al., 2020 ; Wu et al., 2021 ) offer greater realism but are limited to Chinese or English. To our best knowledge, there is no resource providing real-world, multilingual dialogues grounded in real personas within a cooperative setting where pragmatic phenomena such as conflict, misalignment, and evolving viewpoints can emerge—precisely the dynamics that characterize high-stakes scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，现有用于构建基于人格的对话智能体的数据集依赖于虚构人格（Smith et al., 2020；Jang et al., 2022；Xu et al., 2022a；Xu et al., 2022b；Yamashita et al., 2023；Zhao et al., 2025；Lotfi et al., 2023；Chen et al., 2022；Occhipinti et al., 2024），这使得我们无法验证智能体的行为是否真实反映了所模拟的实际人类群体的观点、语言模式和互动动态。 从大规模媒体中提取人格的数据集（Zheng et al., 2020；Wu et al., 2021）具有更高的真实性，但仅限于中文或英文。 据我们所知，目前尚无资源能够提供基于真实人格、在合作情境中展开的真实世界多语言对话——而冲突、观点不一致和观点演变等语用现象正是在此类情境中出现的动态特征，也正是这些动态特征定义了高风险场景。

paragraphs.en: To fill this gap, we introduce Wiki-Talkie , a multilingual dataset of real-world discussions extracted from Wikipedia Talk pages across five languages, where registered users collaboratively deliberate on article edits. Wiki-Talkie enables multifaceted evaluation of agents in a consensus-oriented discussion scenario, with optional conditioning on personas derived from Wikipedia user pages, and behavioral traits from comment histories. To safeguard user privacy, all identities are anonymized and persona profiles are regenerated in a neutral fashion rather than verbatim copies, ensuring privacy protection while maintaining research utility.

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation targets what we term population fidelity : whether agents collectively reproduce the distributional behavioral patterns observed in human discussions, as opposed to individual-level persona fidelity , i.e., whether a single generated response faithfully reflects the provided persona of a specific user. This choice is principled: individual-level fidelity risks enabling faithful simulation of specific individuals, raising ethical concerns around impersonation and lack of consent ( Desai et al., 2025 ) , while population fidelity is more tractable and more relevant for applications such as community simulation and policy analysis. This aligns with an emerging consensus that evaluation of persona-based agents should operate at the population level ( Mansour et al., 2025 ; Rupprecht et al., 2025 ; Fawaz et al., 2026 ) . To assess population fidelity, we frame the task as next-turn generation : given a thread of previous comments, an agent must generate the next comment simulating a specific Wikipedia editor. We conduct evaluations with multiple metrics: instance-level text similarity (ROUGE-L and BERTScore), which provides individual-level signals averaged across the entire dataset, and population-level interactional behavior, comparing sentiment and dialog act distributions ( Searle, 1969 ) between human comments and those generated by agents powered by multiple state-of-the-art LLMs, across five languages. We study how agents behave when conditioned on different types of persona information, comparing behavioral traits extracted from comment histories against explicit persona descriptions derived from user profiles. Results show that cross-lingual differences are small, consistent with prior work on multilingual LLM evaluation showing strong performance across high-resource languages Xuan et al. (2025) ; Li et al. (2025) . We also find that comment history consistently proves more effective than explicit persona information as a conditioning strategy, suggesting that showing how a persona behaves outperforms telling what a persona is.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估针对我们称之为“群体保真度”的指标：即智能体能否整体上再现人类讨论中观察到的行为分布模式，而非仅关注个体层面的“人格保真度”，也就是说，单个生成的回应是否忠实反映了特定用户所提供的人格设定。 这一选择具有理论依据：个体层面的保真度可能使对特定个体的逼真模拟成为可能，从而引发关于身份冒用和缺乏同意的伦理担忧（Desai et al., 2025）；而群体保真度则更易于处理，且对于社区模拟和政策分析等应用更具相关性。 这与逐渐形成的共识一致，即基于人格设定的智能体评估应在群体层面进行（Mansour et al., 2025；Rupprecht et al., 2025；Fawaz et al., 2026）。 为评估群体保真度，我们将任务定义为“下一轮生成”：在给定先前评论的对话线程后，智能体必须生成下一条评论，以模拟一位特定的维基百科编辑。 我们采用多种指标进行评估：实例层面的文本相似度（ROUGE-L 和 BERTScore），可提供在整个数据集上平均计算的个体层面信号；以及群体层面的互动行为，通过比较人类评论与由多个顶尖大语言模型驱动的智能体所生成评论在情感倾向和对话行为类型（Searle, 1969）上的分布差异，覆盖五种语言。 我们研究了智能体在基于不同类型人格信息时表现出的行为差异，将评论历史中提取的行为特征与用户个人资料中明确描述的人格设定进行了对比。 结果表明，跨语言差异很小，这与先前关于多语言大语言模型评估的研究一致，这些研究显示高资源语言模型在各语言间均表现出强劲性能（Xuan et al. (2025)；Li et al. (2025)）。 我们还发现，与使用明确的人格信息相比，将评论历史作为条件输入的策略始终更为有效，这表明展示人格的行为表现比单纯告知其定义更具效果。

paragraphs.en: Overall, our contributions are: 1) the construction of Wiki-Talkie, a dataset of Wikipedia discussions supporting research on agentic interaction simulation, whose key advantages are: a) multilingual coverage; b) real-world discussions reflecting established communication norms; c) ground-truth persona information linked to discussions; and d) rich contextual information, with discussions paired with articles; 2) the evaluation of agents based on four LLMs under various conditioning strategies across five languages, providing insights into the limitations of current agentic simulation of human cooperative interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，我们的贡献包括：1）构建 Wiki-Talkie——一个支持智能体交互模拟研究的数据集，该数据集包含维基百科讨论内容，其主要优势有：a) 多语言覆盖；b) 反映既定沟通规范的现实讨论；c) 与讨论关联的真实人物信息；以及 d) 丰富的上下文信息，讨论与文章相互对应；2）基于四种大型语言模型（LLM），在五种语言中采用不同条件策略对智能体进行评估，从而揭示当前智能体模拟人类合作性交互的局限性。

paragraphs.en: Conversational datasets with persona-related attributes vary in source, language, and use case. Crowdsourced datasets dominate, exemplified by PersonaChat Zhang et al. (2018b) , where crowdworkers converse under fictional personas, and its many extensions: BlendedSkillTalk ( Smith et al., 2020 ) adds empathy and knowledge, FoCus ( Jang et al., 2022 ) adds Wikipedia grounding, Multi-Session Chat ( Xu et al., 2022a ) models longer-term interaction, DuLeMon ( Xu et al., 2022b ) uses Chinese mutual personas, and RealPersonaChat ( Yamashita et al., 2023 ) collects real persona descriptions in Japanese. Other datasets rely on synthetic generation ( Zhao et al., 2025 ; Lotfi et al., 2023 ) or scripted content ( Chen et al., 2022 ; Occhipinti et al., 2024 ) , while social media datasets such as PersonalDialog ( Zheng et al., 2020 ) and PER-CHAT ( Wu et al., 2021 ) extract persona signals from large-scale platforms. Most rely on simulated role-play or synthetic generation and cover few languages: although XPersona ( Lin et al., 2021 ) extends PersonaChat multilingually via automatic translation, naturally occurring interaction datasets remain largely restricted to English and Chinese. Critically, no existing resource simultaneously provides: (i) naturally occurring dialogues, (ii) multilingual coverage, (iii) real user-derived personas linked to the conversations, and (iv) a cooperative yet contentious setting where disagreement, negotiation, and consensus-building emerge. We address this gap with Wiki-Talkie.
paragraphs.zh: 包含角色相关属性的对话数据集在来源、语言和应用场景上各不相同。众包数据集占据主导地位，典型例子是 PersonaChat（Zhang 等人，2018b），其中众包工作者以虚构的角色身份进行对话；此外还有其众多扩展版本：BlendedSkillTalk（Smith 等人，2020）加入了同理心和知识元素，FoCus（Jang 等人，2022）增加了维基百科背景知识，Multi-Session Chat（Xu 等人，2022a）模拟了更长期的互动，DuLeMon（Xu 等人，2022b）使用了中文互设角色，而 RealPersonaChat（Yamashita 等人，2023）则收集了真实的日语角色描述。其他数据集则依赖合成生成（Zhao 等人，2025；Lotfi 等人，2023）或脚本化内容（Chen 等人，2022；Occhipinti 等人，2024），而社交媒体数据集（如 PersonalDialog（Zheng 等人，2020）和 PER-CHAT（Wu 等人，2021））则从大型平台中提取角色特征。大多数数据集依赖模拟角色扮演或合成生成，且覆盖的语言种类有限：尽管 XPersona（Lin 等人，2021）通过自动翻译将 PersonaChat 扩展到了多语言，但自然发生的互动数据集仍然主要局限于英语和中文。关键问题是，目前没有任何资源能同时满足以下四个条件：(i) 自然发生的对话；(ii) 多语言覆盖；(iii) 与对话相关联的真实用户角色描述；以及 (iv) 一种既具合作性又存在争议的场景，其中分歧、协商和共识构建能够自然产生。我们通过 Wiki-Talkie 填补了这一空白。

paragraphs.en: A growing body of work documents systematic biases in LLM-generated social behavior. LLMs exhibit sycophantic tendencies, preferring agreement over truthful disagreement ( Malmqvist, 2025 ) , and display a positivity bias that suppresses negative or confrontational outputs ( Santurkar et al., 2023 ) . Studies using LLMs to simulate human populations have shown that, while persona conditioning can improve alignment with survey response distributions ( Argyle et al., 2023 ) , models often fail to reproduce the full diversity of human opinions and behaviors ( Orlikowski et al., 2025 ) . However, these findings are predominantly based on English-only settings, synthetic survey tasks, or opinion elicitation, leaving open the question of whether such biases persist in naturalistic, multilingual, cooperative discussions. Wiki-Talkie addresses this gap by providing a testbed where LLM social behavior can be evaluated against real human interactions across five languages in a collaborative setting with genuine disagreement and pragmatic complexity.
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的研究记录了大型语言模型（LLM）生成的社交行为中存在的系统性偏见。 LLM 表现出阿谀奉承的倾向，更倾向于同意而非坦诚地提出异议（Malmqvist, 2025），并展现出一种抑制负面或对抗性输出的积极偏见（Santurkar et al., 2023）。 使用 LLM 模拟人类群体的研究表明，尽管角色设定能够提升模型与调查回答分布的一致性（Argyle et al., 2023），但这些模型往往无法再现人类意见和行为的完整多样性（Orlikowski et al., 2025）。 然而，这些发现主要基于仅限英语的环境、合成调查任务或意见收集，因此这类偏见是否也会出现在自然、多语言且具合作性的讨论中仍是一个悬而未决的问题。 Wiki-Talkie 通过提供一个测试平台来解决这一空白，在该平台上，可以评估 LLM 的社交行为在与真实人类互动中的表现，涵盖五种语言，并涉及协作场景中的真实分歧和实用复杂性。

paragraphs.en: Wikipedia Talk pages remain underexplored despite providing large-scale, naturally occurring collaborative dialogue Johnson et al. (2024) . Prior work has used them to study conversational behavior and harmful interactions ( Wulczyn et al., 2017 ; Zhang et al., 2018a ) , dialogue act classification Ferschke et al. (2012) , dispute detection Wang and Cardie (2014) , sociolinguistics Prabhakaran and Rambow (2016) , abuse ( Cécillon et al., 2020 ) , and links between discussions and edit histories ( Jaidka et al., 2021 ) . WikiConv ( Hua et al., 2018 ) reconstructs full conversational histories including edits and deletions, supporting tasks such as preemptive toxicity detection ( Karan and Šnajder, 2019 ) . However, these datasets focus on discourse structure, conflict, or toxicity, remain mostly English-centric, and lack persistent persona representations for multilingual evaluation. To our knowledge, Talk pages have not been used to analyze LLM behavior in socially grounded, collaborative settings.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管维基百科讨论页提供了大规模、自然发生的协作性对话，但它们仍未得到充分探索（Johnson et al., 2024）。先前的研究已利用这些页面来探讨对话行为与有害互动（Wulczyn et al., 2017；Zhang et al., 2018a）、对话行为分类（Ferschke et al., 2012）、争议检测（Wang and Cardie, 2014）、社会语言学（Prabhakaran and Rambow, 2016）、滥用行为（Cécillon et al., 2020），以及讨论与编辑历史之间的关联（Jaidka et al., 2021）。WikiConv（Hua et al., 2018）重建了包含编辑和删除操作的完整对话历史，从而支持诸如提前检测毒性内容等任务（Karan and Šnajder, 2019）。然而，这些数据集主要关注话语结构、冲突或毒性，且大多以英语为中心，缺乏可用于多语言评估的持久化角色身份表示。据我们所知，讨论页尚未被用于分析大型语言模型在具有社会背景的合作性场景中的行为。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Wiki-Talkie , a multilingual dataset of real-world discussions extracted from Wikipedia Talk pages across five languages spanning two language families: Germanic (German, English) and Romance (Spanish, French, Italian). Wiki-Talkie is built around three core components (see Figure 1 ): 1) multilingual threads in which users deliberate on article content; 2) user personas from two complementary sources, a self-reported profile derived from Wikipedia user pages (with attributes such as gender, profession, interests, and contribution topics) and behavioral traits inferred from each user’s comment history; and 3) the article context, paired with each thread as it appeared immediately before the discussion began. Together, these components make Wiki-Talkie suited for research on persona-conditioned and document-grounded interaction modeling across languages. 4 4 4 Examples are in Appendix B , Tables 6 – 10 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Wiki-Talkie，这是一个多语言数据集，包含从五种语言的维基百科讨论页中提取的真实世界讨论，涵盖日耳曼语系（德语、英语）和罗曼语系（西班牙语、法语、意大利语）。 Wiki-Talkie 围绕三个核心组件构建（参见图 1）：1）多语言讨论线程，用户在其中对文章内容进行商议；2）来自两个互补来源的用户角色设定，包括从维基百科用户页面获取的自我报告资料（包含性别、职业、兴趣及贡献主题等属性），以及根据每位用户的评论历史推断出的行为特征；3）与每个讨论线程配套的文章背景信息，即讨论开始前直接呈现的内容。 这些组件共同使 Wiki-Talkie 适用于跨语言的研究，特别是针对受用户角色设定影响且以文档为基础的交流建模。4 4 4 示例见附录 B 中的表 6–10。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 presents summary statistics of Wiki-Talkie across languages (full distributions in Appendix A.1.1 ). German contributes the largest portion (>42K threads, >134K turns), followed by French and English, while Spanish and Italian form smaller subsets. Despite differences in scale, structural characteristics are remarkably consistent across languages: threads contain on average 3.2--3.6 turns and involve 2.1--2.3 unique users. 5 5 5 These statistics are not necessarily representative of Wikipedia Talk pages at large, but reflect our construction pipeline (Section 3.1 ). Turn length varies more, ranging from 47.74 words (German) to 79.73 (Spanish), potentially reflecting differences in editorial culture or linguistic verbosity. High standard deviations across all metrics indicate substantial variability, consistent with discussions ranging from brief clarifications to extended debates. The number of unique users mirrors the thread distribution; further details on users and personas are in Appendix A.1.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 表1展示了Wiki-Talkie在不同语言中的摘要统计信息（完整分布见附录A.1.1）。 德语贡献了最大的部分（>4.2万条线程，>13.4万轮对话），其次是法语和英语，而西班牙语和意大利语则构成了较小的子集。 尽管规模存在差异，但各语言的结构特征表现出显著的一致性：每条线程平均包含3.2--3.6轮对话，并涉及2.1--2.3名独立用户。5 5 5 这些统计数据未必能代表维基百科讨论页的整体情况，而是反映了我们的构建流程（第3.1节）。 对话轮的长度差异较大，从德语的47.74词到西班牙语的79.73词不等，这可能反映了编辑文化或语言表达繁简程度的差异。 所有指标的高标准差表明存在显著的可变性，这与讨论内容从简短澄清到长时间辩论的情况相符。 独立用户的数量与线程分布相对应；关于用户和角色的更多细节见附录A.1.2。

paragraphs.en: The threads contained in Wiki-Talkie are extracted from raw Wikipedia Talk page dumps. 6 6 6 Dumps from October 2025: https://dumps.wikimedia.org/<lang_code>wiki/20251001/ . Wikipedia Talk pages are largely unstructured, making clean conversation extraction a challenging preprocessing task Ferschke et al. (2012) ; Hua et al. (2018) . We exploit standard conventions: MediaWiki heading syntax for topics, username-timestamp signatures, and colon-based reply indentation, and handcrafted regular expressions to parse threads into flat sequential turns ordered by timestamps 7 7 7 See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Talk_page_guidelines . . To address extraction errors, we prompted the extractor model to revise threads by correcting turn boundaries and comment attributions, flagging irrecoverable cases for exclusion (prompt reported in Appendix C , Figure 10 ).
paragraphs.zh: Wiki-Talkie 中包含的对话线程是从维基百科原始讨论页数据快照中提取的。6 6 6 2025年10月的数据快照：https://dumps.wikimedia.org/<lang_code>wiki/20251001/ . 维基百科讨论页大多没有结构化，因此干净地提取对话是一项具有挑战性的预处理任务 Ferschke et al. (2012) ; Hua et al. (2018) . 我们利用了标准惯例：MediaWiki 的标题语法用于标识主题、用户名-时间戳签名以及基于冒号的回复缩进，并使用了人工设计的正则表达式，将对话线程解析为按时间戳排序的扁平化顺序轮次 7 7 7 参见 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Talk_page_guidelines . . 为解决提取错误问题，我们提示提取模型通过修正轮次边界和评论归属来修订对话线程，并将无法修复的情况标记出来予以排除（提示见附录 C、图10）。

paragraphs.en: For each unique user in the extracted threads, we fetched the corresponding Wikipedia user page via the MediaWiki API. 8 8 8 https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/API , accessed through mwclient ( https://github.com/mwclient/mwclient ). User pages are optional personal spaces where editors describe themselves, their interests, expertise, and contributions. We prompted the extractor model to determine whether a page contained relevant biographical or self-descriptive content, excluding pages consisting solely of administrative templates or userboxes (prompt in Appendix C , Figure 15 ). For pages with substantive content, the model also generated a natural-language profile summarizing all available details, following recent work on LLM-based persona extraction ( Zhang, 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Mansour et al., 2025 ) . Because these are self-declared attributes from real users, the resulting personas avoid the stereotypical or synthetic quality of artificially constructed profiles and naturally incorporate sociodemographic aspects, making them valuable for evaluating how such factors influence agent behavior and biases. Alongside the profile, the model extracted predefined attributes in JSON format (e.g., primary editing topics, gender, profession) to support statistical analysis of user subgroups. Users with successfully generated profiles were subsampled to at most 10,000 per language, prioritizing presence of contribution topics, then gender (favoring women and non-binary users to counteract imbalance), then profession. Only threads where all participants belong to the selected subset were retained.

paragraphs.en: From each user’s comments (across up to 50 randomly sampled threads), we extracted behavioral traits using the extractor model, characterizing each user along eight dimensions including (dis)agreement strategy and editing behavior. paragraphs.en: Wiki-Talkie supports tasks including comment generation, summarization, and quality assessment. Here, we frame the task as next-turn generation : given the preceding comments in a thread, an agent is asked to generate the next comment in the role of the real user who authored it. We always condition on at least one preceding comment (i.e., the first turn is never generated from scratch), and prior context always consists of ground-truth comments. This task formulation was chosen deliberately to enable controlled, comparable evaluation across languages and conditioning strategies, resulting in over 100 experimental conditions (5 languages × \times 4 models × \times 5 conditioning methods). Although Wiki-Talkie supports evaluation along several dimensions—including coherence with context, factual grounding in the associated article, and fidelity to persona conditioning—here we focus on interaction behavior of agents.
paragraphs.zh: Wiki-Talkie 支持的任务包括评论生成、摘要生成和质量评估。 在此，我们将该任务定义为“下一轮生成”：给定对话线程中的先前评论，智能体需要以撰写这些评论的真实用户的身份生成下一条评论。 我们始终至少以一条先前评论作为条件（即第一轮评论绝不会从头生成），且所有先前上下文均包含真实评论。 我们特意选择这种任务设定，以便在不同语言和条件策略之间进行受控且可比较的评估，从而产生了超过 100 种实验条件（5 种语言 × 4 种模型 × 5 种条件方法）。 尽管 Wiki-Talkie 支持沿多个维度进行评估——包括与上下文的连贯性、在相关文章中的事实依据以及对角色设定的忠实度——但在此我们重点关注智能体的交互行为。

paragraphs.en: We defined five conditioning methods to investigate how different types of persona information shape agent behavior in interactions: i) base role-play, where the agent is instructed that it is a Wikipedia editor with no additional information; ii) profile , where the agent is provided with the self-reported profile (gender, age, profession, etc.) of the user who produced the target comment; iii) behavior , where the agent is provided with the user’s behavioral traits; iv) behavior+r , same as behavior but including the extractor model’s reasoning; v) history , where the agent is provided with 5-20 comments by the same user (randomly sampled if more are available), enabling indirect conditioning through stylistic and behavioral patterns in prior contributions. The prompts for each method are provided in Appendix C , Figures 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们定义了五种条件设定方法，以研究不同类型的人设信息如何影响智能体在互动中的行为：i) 基础角色扮演，即指示智能体扮演维基百科编辑，不提供任何额外信息；ii) 个人资料，即向智能体提供生成目标评论的用户自我报告的个人资料（性别、年龄、职业等）；iii) 行为特征，即向智能体提供用户的行为特征；iv) 行为特征+推理，与行为特征相同，但包含提取模型的推理过程；v) 历史评论，即向智能体提供该用户的 5-20 条评论（如果可用评论超过此数量则随机抽样），从而通过其过往贡献中的风格和行为模式进行间接条件设定。 每种方法的提示词均列于附录 C 以及图 14、15、16、17 中。

paragraphs.en: We run experiments with four state-of-the-art models spanning both open-source and proprietary systems: Model A (proprietary), Model B, Model C, and Model D (open-weights). 9 9 9 Model identities are withheld; we report results under anonymized labels (Model A–Model D). All four are widely-used frontier LLMs at the top of their respective open-weights and proprietary classes at the time of writing, chosen to ensure that our findings reflect the behavior of strong, competitive systems rather than artifacts of weak models. Implementation and generation details are provided in Appendix E .

paragraphs.en: Our primary focus is interactional behavior . We extract dialogue acts using the taxonomy of Ferschke et al. (2012) , developed for Wikipedia Talk pages, considering 10 acts: critique , request , reference , commit , report , inform , ask , positive , negative , and partial . 11 11 11 Mapping to Ferschke et al. (2012) is in Appendix F . Both human and agent comments are annotated with the extractor model as LLM annotator (prompt in Appendix C , Figure 12 ), which achieves 0.76 F1 against human judgment (Appendix F ). Each comment can carry one or multiple acts. We additionally assess overall response tone via sentiment prediction on both human and agent comments. 12 12 12 Using the multilingual model https://huggingface.co/tabularisai/multilingual-sentiment-analysis , predicting on a five-point scale from very negative to very positive .

paragraphs.en: Across both languages and models, history consistently yields the highest similarity, with ROUGE-L up to 0.154 0.154 (Model A in es ) and rBERT up to 0.105 0.105 (Model A in de ). behavior+r is the second most effective, with consistent gains over base (e.g., ROUGE-L up to 0.138 0.138 for Model A in es ; rBERT up to 0.085 0.085 for Model A in de ). By contrast, profile generally degrades similarity relative to base (e.g., rBERT drops on average from 0.053 0.053 to 0.040 0.040 for Model A, and from − 0.017 -0.017 to − 0.049 -0.049 for Model D), likely because prompting agents to reflect persona traits leads them to incorporate non-relevant details, producing longer and more elaborated responses without improving content alignment. Indeed, agent comments are consistently longer than human comments across all conditions (Appendix G ). behavior similarly fails to improve similarity for most models and languages, with only modest gains in some cases (e.g., Model B’s ROUGE-L from 0.078 0.078 to 0.082 0.082 ).

paragraphs.en: Overall, concrete demonstrations —through comment histories ( history ) or behavioral traits paired with reasoning ( behavior+r )— are more effective than abstract descriptions ( behavior ) and sociodemographic information ( profile ) at steering agent output toward human-like text. This is the dominant pattern across models and languages, while cross-lingual differences remain small , though we note that all five languages are high-resource and European. The consistency is nonetheless non-trivial given that they span two language families and differ in Wikipedia community size and editorial norms.

paragraphs.en: Overall, these results reinforce the pattern observed for text similarity: concrete behavioral demonstrations ( history , behavior+r ) are consistently more effective than abstract descriptions or sociodemographic factors ( behavior , profile ) at aligning agent behavior with human distributions, echoing the well-established advantage of few-shot over zero-shot conditioning Brown et al. (2020) .
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，这些结果进一步印证了文本相似性观察到的模式：具体的行为演示（history、behavior+r）在使智能体行为与人类分布保持一致方面，始终比抽象描述或社会人口统计学因素（behavior、profile）更为有效，这与少样本条件相对于零样本条件的公认优势相呼应 Brown et al. (2020)。

paragraphs.en: One might wonder whether this gap reflects a difference in information type or simply in information quantity , since history provides 5–20 raw comments while profile and behavior supply compressed summaries. We address this concern in Appendix H , where we show that performance under profile does not improve consistently with profile length: ROUGE-L and rBERT are flat, and where acts and sentiment JSD change, they mostly worsen with longer profiles. Combined with the observation that profile degrades performance relative to base despite adding tokens, this argues against a pure context-budget explanation and supports our interpretation that the operative factor is information type, not quantity.
paragraphs.zh: 人们或许会疑问，这种差距是反映信息类型的差异，还是仅仅信息数量的差异，因为历史数据提供了 5–20 条原始评论，而个人档案和行为数据则提供了压缩后的摘要。 我们在附录 H 中处理了这一担忧，其中我们表明，使用个人档案时的性能并不会随着个人档案长度的增加而持续改善：ROUGE-L 和 rBERT 的性能保持不变，而行为和情感分析的 JSD 虽然有所变化，但通常在个人档案更长时表现更差。 结合这样一个观察结果——尽管增加了词元，但个人档案相对于基础模型而言反而降低了性能——这一发现反驳了纯粹由上下文预算限制的解释，并支持我们的解读：起作用的因素是信息类型，而非信息数量。

paragraphs.en: To assess whether divergences concentrate on specific labels, we analyze per-label proportion differences ( δ \delta ) between human and agent distributions, where positive values indicate human over-production and negative values indicate agent over-production. Figure 4 shows differences averaged across languages, omitting acts with negligible variation ( Ask , Critique , Positive , Partial ). paragraphs.en: We introduced Wiki-Talkie, a multilingual dataset derived from Wikipedia Talk pages to evaluate agent interactions across five languages, using four state-of-the-art LLMs under different persona conditioning strategies. Our evaluation targets population fidelity—whether agents collectively reproduce the distributional behavioral patterns of human communities—complemented by instance-level text similarity metrics. Our experiments show that grounding agents with concrete comment examples consistently outperforms abstract persona descriptions across all languages. Notably, sociodemographic information can degrade agent performance, an encouraging finding for privacy-preserving applications. In addition, agents are consistently more action-oriented and less confrontational than humans, revealing a bias toward agreeableness and avoidance of extremes. Cross-lingual differences remain small, with English showing only slightly greater alignment. Overall, these results underscore both the promise and limitations of persona-conditioned generation, motivating further research into more effective simulation strategies. While we focused on next-turn generation to enable controlled comparison across a large experimental space, Wiki-Talkie is designed to support richer evaluation settings, including multi-turn generation, summarization, factual grounding assessment, and quality evaluation, all of which we encourage the community to explore.
paragraphs.zh: 我们推出了 Wiki-Talkie，这是一个源自维基百科讨论页面的多语言数据集，用于评估智能体在五种语言中的交互表现，并采用了四种当前最先进的 LLM 模型以及不同的人格设定策略。 我们的评估目标是群体保真度——即智能体能否整体上再现人类社群的行为分布模式——并通过实例层面的文本相似度指标加以补充验证。 我们的实验表明，为智能体提供具体的评论示例作为基础，在所有语言中均能持续优于使用抽象人格描述的方法。 值得注意的是，社会人口统计学信息可能会降低智能体的表现，这一发现对于隐私保护类应用而言具有积极意义。 此外，智能体的行为始终比人类更具行动导向且更少对抗性，这揭示了其倾向于表现出友善并避免极端行为的倾向。 跨语言差异仍然较小，其中英语的表现仅略微更趋一致。 总体而言，这些结果凸显了人格设定驱动生成方法的前景与局限性，也推动了对更有效模拟策略的进一步研究。 尽管我们专注于下一轮对话的生成，以便在大规模实验空间中实现受控比较，但 Wiki-Talkie 的设计支持更丰富的评估场景，包括多轮对话生成、摘要提取、事实依据评估和质量评价，我们鼓励社区进一步探索这些方向。

paragraphs.en: Despite our multi-stage extraction and revision pipeline, some residual noise remains in Wiki-Talkie, including occasional misattributed comments, imperfect comment boundaries, and formatting artifacts not fully resolved during preprocessing Such noise is inevitable at this scale and is unlikely to substantially affect evaluation or analysis.

paragraphs.en: Wiki-Talkie currently covers five European languages (English, German, Spanish, French, and Italian), limiting its cultural and linguistic diversity. While these languages span two distinct families (Romance and Germanic) and vary in Wikipedia community size and editorial norms, they are all high-resource; findings may not generalize to language communities with different writing systems, discourse conventions, or editorial practices. Future work should extend Wiki-Talkie to additional languages, particularly those underrepresented in NLP research. The dataset construction pipeline and evaluation framework are fully language-agnostic and straightforwardly extensible to lower-resource and non-European languages.

English is generally better represented in both quantity and quality, meaning persona conditioning experiments may be more reliable for English than for other languages. paragraphs.en: Our experiments focus exclusively on prompting-based persona conditioning, leaving alternative approaches to future work, such as fine-tuning (e.g., Thakur et al., 2024 ; Takayama et al., 2025 ), retrieval-augmented conditioning (e.g., Huang et al., 2023 ; Salemi et al., 2024 ), or embedding-based persona representations (e.g, Liu et al., 2025b ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验完全聚焦于基于提示的 persona 条件设定，而将其他方法（例如微调（如 Thakur 等人，2024；Takayama 等人，2025）、检索增强型条件设定（如 Huang 等人，2023；Salemi 等人，2024），或基于嵌入的 persona 表示（如 Liu 等人，2025b））留待未来研究。

paragraphs.en: Our conditioning methods are not strictly matched on information density: history provides 5–20 raw comments, while profile and behavior supply compressed summaries. We probe this confound in Appendix H by stratifying profile performance by profile length and find no consistent improvement with profile length across four metrics, supporting an information-type rather than information-quantity interpretation. We did not perform the analogous analysis for history length because the conditioning pool is concentrated in the 16–20 comment range, leaving lower-comment buckets too sparse to support a meaningful comparison. A fully matched ablation—e.g., comparing history against equally long synthetic summaries distilled from the same comments—remains a direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的条件化方法在信息密度上并非严格匹配：历史数据提供 5–20 条原始评论，而个人资料和行为则提供压缩后的摘要。 我们在附录 H 中通过按个人资料长度对个人资料性能进行分层分析，探究了这一混淆因素，并发现四项指标均未随个人资料长度的增加而表现出一致的提升，这支持了信息类型而非信息数量的解释。 我们没有对历史数据长度进行类似的分析，因为条件化池主要集中在 16–20 条评论的范围内，导致评论较少的区间过于稀疏，无法支持有意义的比较。 一种完全匹配的消融研究——例如，将历史数据与从相同评论中提炼出的等长合成摘要进行比较——仍然是未来工作的一个方向。

paragraphs.en: Our profiles and behavioral traits are produced by a single anonymized extractor model and a specific prompting design. A manual audit (Appendix I ) indicates that these representations are largely faithful and well-grounded, with imprecisions limited to isolated factual details. Nonetheless, our findings about profile and behavior should be read as conclusions about sociodemographic and behavioral descriptors as we generated them , rather than as universal claims about all possible persona representations. Alternative summarization strategies, richer attribute schemas, or different extractor models could in principle yield different results.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的个人资料和行为特征是由一个单一的匿名化提取模型和特定的提示设计生成的。 人工审计（附录 I）表明，这些表征在很大程度上是忠实且依据充分的，不精确之处仅限于个别事实细节。 尽管如此，关于个人资料和行为的发现应被理解为对我们所生成的人口社会学描述和行为描述者的结论，而非对所有可能的人物表征的普遍论断。 原则上，替代的摘要策略、更丰富的属性架构或不同的提取模型可能会产生不同的结果。

paragraphs.en: Our primary evaluation target is population fidelity —whether agents collectively reproduce the distributional behavioral patterns observed in human discussions—rather than individual-level persona fidelity , i.e., whether each generated response faithfully reflects the specific persona provided. This choice is principled: individual-level fidelity risks enabling faithful simulation of specific individuals, raising ethical concerns around impersonation and lack of consent ( Desai et al., 2025 ) , while population fidelity is more tractable and more relevant for applications such as community simulation and policy analysis, in line with recent work advocating population-level evaluation of persona-based agents ( Mansour et al., 2025 ; Fawaz et al., 2026 ; Rupprecht et al., 2025 ) . Assessing fine-grained individual-level persona consistency remains a direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要评估目标是群体保真度——即智能体能否共同再现人类讨论中观察到的行为分布模式——而非个体层面的人设保真度，也就是说，每个生成的回应是否忠实反映了所提供的具体人设。 这一选择是有原则依据的：个体层面的保真度可能使对特定个体的逼真模拟成为可能，从而引发关于身份冒用和缺乏同意的伦理担忧（Desai et al., 2025）；而群体保真度则更易于处理，且对于社区模拟和政策分析等应用更具相关性，这与近期倡导对人设驱动型智能体进行群体层面评估的研究一致（Mansour et al., 2025; Fawaz et al., 2026; Rupprecht et al., 2025）。 评估精细的个体层面人设一致性仍然是未来工作的一个方向。

paragraphs.en: Wiki-Talkie is derived from Wikipedia dumps, released under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 license. While publicly accessible, we recognize that contributors may reasonably expect their comments to be archived for research purposes but not necessarily used for persona-conditioned simulation. Accordingly, we treat this dataset as human-derived data requiring safeguards beyond copyright compliance, guided by the principles of data minimization, proportionality, contextual integrity, and harm reduction.
paragraphs.zh: Wiki-Talkie 源自维基百科数据快照，并根据知识共享署名-相同方式共享 4.0 许可协议发布。 尽管该数据集可供公众访问，但我们认识到，贡献者可能合理地期望他们的评论被存档用于研究目的，但未必会被用于基于角色特征的模拟。 因此，我们将此数据集视为源自人类的数据，需要采取超越版权合规性的保障措施，并遵循数据最小化、比例性、情境完整性和危害减少等原则。

paragraphs.en: The dataset does not contain original user pages verbatim. Instead, we generated neutral, natural-language re-elaborations summarizing publicly stated interests and interactional patterns, deliberately omitting usernames, real names, contact information, and external links. This process inherently introduces a layer of abstraction: the resulting profiles are approximate characterizations that may diverge from the original content through omission, rephrasing, or occasional inaccuracy. While this means profiles should not be treated as ground-truth descriptions of actual persons, we acknowledge that the same process may occasionally introduce erroneous attributes, including sensitive ones. We sought to mitigate this risk through manual inspection of a random sample of outputs (see Appendix I ).
paragraphs.zh: 该数据集并未逐字收录原始用户页面内容。 相反，我们生成了中立的、使用自然语言重新阐述的内容，以概括公开声明的兴趣和互动模式，并刻意省略了用户名、真实姓名、联系信息和外部链接。 这一过程本质上引入了一层抽象：最终生成的个人资料是近似的特征描述，可能因内容遗漏、措辞改写或偶尔的不准确而与原始内容产生偏差。 虽然这意味着这些个人资料不应被视为对实际人物的绝对准确描述，但我们承认，同一过程偶尔也可能引入错误属性，包括敏感信息。 我们通过对随机抽取的输出样本进行人工检查（参见附录 I），力求降低这一风险。

paragraphs.en: Usernames are replaced using salted cryptographic hashing, where the salt is stored separately from the dataset and is accessible only to the principal investigator, preventing straightforward reversal or precomputation attacks (see Appendix A.2 ). Within comment text, we also anonymized mentions of third-party usernames to the extent possible. However, a residual risk remains where usernames appear in non-standard forms or where real names are mentioned in conversation.
paragraphs.zh: 用户名通过加盐加密哈希进行替换，其中盐值与数据集分开存储，且仅首席研究员可访问，从而防止直接的逆向或预计算攻击（参见附录 A.2）。 在评论文本中，我们也在尽可能范围内对第三方用户名的提及进行了匿名化处理。 然而，当用户名以非标准形式出现，或对话中提及真实姓名时，仍存在残余风险。

paragraphs.en: Complete anonymity cannot be guaranteed when working with public textual data. While salted hashing prevents trivial username reconstruction, a content-based re-identification risk exists: because Wikipedia discussions are publicly archived and indexed, motivated individuals could potentially identify original authors via distinctive phrases or search queries. Our dataset does not introduce new exposure beyond what is already publicly accessible, but we recognize that aggregation and structuring may lower the cost of such searches.
paragraphs.zh: 在处理公开文本数据时，无法保证完全的匿名性。 虽然加盐哈希可以防止轻易地重建用户名，但仍存在基于内容的重新识别风险：由于维基百科讨论内容已被公开存档和索引，有动机的人可能通过独特的短语或搜索查询来识别原始作者。 我们的数据集并未引入超出现有公开可获取范围的新暴露风险，但我们认识到，数据的聚合与结构化可能会降低此类搜索的成本。

paragraphs.en: To mitigate these risks, the dataset is released under the CC BY-SA 4.0 license, inherited from the underlying Wikipedia-derived content. Rather than hosting an open public mirror, we distribute it through a lightweight access request in which prospective users identify themselves and their intended use. This provides an audit trail and a point of contact while raising the effort required for indiscriminate bulk access. As a matter of research norms rather than a binding condition, we ask that recipients not attempt to de-anonymize contributors, not use the data to impersonate or manipulate editorial processes, and work from the most recent release.
paragraphs.zh: 为缓解这些风险，该数据集在 CC BY-SA 4.0 许可协议下发布，此许可协议继承自其底层源自维基百科的内容。 我们并未设立一个开放的公共镜像站点，而是通过轻量级的访问请求进行分发，潜在用户需在其中说明自身身份及预期用途。 此举既提供了审计追踪和联系渠道，也增加了无差别批量访问所需付出的努力。 出于研究规范而非强制性条件的考虑，我们要求接收方不得尝试去匿名化贡献者，不得利用该数据冒充或操控编辑流程，并应基于最新发布的版本开展工作。

Upon verification, corresponding entries are added to a blocklist and removed in subsequent releases. Our goal is risk mitigation rather than elimination, and we consider the residual risk proportionate to the scientific value of studying collaborative online deliberation at scale.

paragraphs.en: Individual informed consent was not sought, as contributions to Wikipedia are made under the CC BY-SA license and the Wikimedia Foundation’s Terms of Use, which explicitly permit reuse and derivative works. This is consistent with established practice in NLP research on Wikipedia-derived data ( Ferschke et al., 2012 ; Hua et al., 2018 ) , and the scale of contributors makes individual consent infeasible. Nevertheless, we recognize that licensing permissibility does not fully resolve the ethical tension between contributors’ original communicative intent and downstream research applications; we address this gap through the layered safeguards described above.
paragraphs.zh: 我们并未征求个人的知情同意，因为对维基百科的贡献均基于 CC BY-SA 许可协议和维基媒体基金会的《使用条款》，这些协议明确允许内容的再利用和衍生创作。 这一做法与基于维基百科数据的自然语言处理研究中的既有惯例一致（Ferschke 等人，2012；Hua 等人，2018），且贡献者规模庞大使得逐一征求同意变得不切实际。 尽管如此，我们认识到许可的宽容性并不能完全化解贡献者最初沟通意图与下游研究应用之间的伦理张力；我们通过上述分层的保障机制来弥合这一差距。

paragraphs.en: Wikipedia Talk pages may occasionally contain harassment, conflictual exchanges, or incidental personal disclosures. We do not seek to amplify or foreground such content; the dataset is designed to analyze aggregate interaction patterns in collaborative environments, not for reputational analysis of specific contributors. We did not apply active content filtering in order to preserve the ecological validity of the discussions. Access restrictions are intended to further prevent misuse or amplification of harmful material.
paragraphs.zh: 维基百科的讨论页偶尔可能包含骚扰、冲突性交流或偶然出现的个人披露内容。 我们无意放大或突出此类内容；该数据集旨在分析协作环境中整体的互动模式，而非用于对特定贡献者进行声誉分析。 为了保持讨论的生态效度，我们没有应用主动的内容过滤机制。 访问限制旨在进一步防止有害材料的滥用或扩散。

paragraphs.en: The objective of this research is not to recreate, approximate, or impersonate specific individuals. Persona-conditioned agents are stochastic constructs derived from coarse behavioral summaries, used solely to examine population-level dynamics in simulated group discussions. Although individual-level conditioning is methodologically necessary to capture heterogeneity in interaction styles, all evaluation and reporting are conducted at the aggregate level. We do not evaluate model fidelity to specific users, publish individual outputs, or claim to model the beliefs, intentions, or identities of real contributors.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究的目标并非重现、近似或模仿特定个体。 基于人格设定智能体是源自粗略行为总结的随机构建物，仅用于在模拟小组讨论中考察群体层面的动态变化。 尽管从方法论上讲，个体层面的设定对于捕捉互动方式的异质性是必要的，但所有评估和报告均在聚合层面进行。 我们不评估模型对特定用户的忠实度，不发布个体输出，也不声称能够模拟真实参与者的信念、意图或身份。

paragraphs.en: We recognize that repurposing public discourse for AI research raises novel ethical questions concerning digital representation and contextual integrity. Our ethical justification rests on proportionality: the scientific value of understanding large-scale collaborative behavior, combined with layered safeguards (anonymization, profile re-elaboration, controlled access, opt-out mechanisms), outweighs the residual and mitigated risks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认识到，将公共话语重新用于人工智能研究会引发关于数字呈现和语境完整性的全新伦理问题。 我们的伦理依据建立在比例性原则之上：理解大规模协作行为的科学价值，结合多层防护机制（匿名化处理、个人资料重构、受控访问和退出机制），其益处超过了残余且已得到缓解的风险。

paragraphs.en: In Table 2 , we show statistics on users and personas, with Figure 7 showing the corresponding word distributions for user pages and profiles. User pages are right-skewed across all languages, with most users having short pages and a minority producing substantially longer ones. Profiles follow a more bell-shaped distribution centered around 50–100 words, reflecting the relatively standardized length of the persona descriptions we construct from user metadata, and confirming that our persona extraction distills user information into concise, consistent summaries regardless of the underlying page length. English users exhibit the richest descriptions, with both the longest average user pages and profile lengths (98.07 words), and near-complete coverage of contribution topics (100%), gender (67%), and profession (66%), reflecting the larger and more active English Wikipedia community. German users, while numerous, show lower rates of gender (36%) and profession (26%) disclosure despite high topic coverage (98.9%). Spanish, French, and Italian users display more modest attribute coverage, particularly for profession, reflecting sparser self-descriptions in these communities. The column reporting users with at least five turns indicates a core of highly active contributors in each language, ranging from approximately 30% (Spanish, Italian) to nearly 50% (German).
paragraphs.zh: 在表 2 中，我们展示了用户和人物设定的统计数据，图 7 则显示了用户页面和个人资料对应的词分布情况。 所有语言中的用户页面均呈现右偏态分布，大多数用户的页面较短，而少数用户的页面则明显更长。 个人资料的分布更接近钟形曲线，中心集中在 50–100 个词左右，这反映了我们从用户元数据中构建的人物设定描述具有相对标准化的长度，也证实了我们的人物设定提取方法能够将用户信息提炼为简洁且一致的高度概括，无论其原始页面的长度如何。 英语用户的描述最为丰富，其平均用户页面和个人资料长度均最长（98.07 个词），且贡献主题（100%）、性别（67%）和职业（66%）的覆盖比例接近完全，这反映了英语维基百科社区规模更大、活跃度更高。 德语用户数量众多，但尽管主题覆盖率高（98.9%），其性别（36%）和职业（26%）的披露率却较低。 西班牙语、法语和意大利语用户的属性覆盖情况较为有限，尤其是职业信息，这反映了这些社区中自我描述的内容相对较少。 报告至少参与五次交互的用户数量的列显示，每种语言都存在一个高度活跃的核心贡献者群体，比例从大约 30%（西班牙语、意大利语）到接近 50%（德语）不等。

paragraphs.en: Figure 8 shows the proportion of non-deducible or, less frequently, malformed behavioral trait values across all users, broken down by trait and language. Agreement Strategy , Consensus Orientation , and Disagreement Strategy consistently account for the largest shares across all languages, possibly due to the lower frequency of these behavioral aspects in user comments. paragraphs.en: All usernames in Wiki-Talkie are anonymized via deterministic hashing with a keyed hash function and salt, ensuring consistent mapping across the dataset while preventing reversal. Username occurrences are identified and replaced not only in structured metadata but also within comment text, where editors frequently mention one another through wikilink syntax or plain text references. 13 13 13 For risks associated with user re-identification, see Ethic Statement Section. Thread formatting is then cleaned and normalized: leading and trailing decorative characters (dashes, equals signs) are removed, HTML line breaks are converted to newlines, styling tags ( <div> , <span> , <u> ) are stripped while preserving content, <nowiki> and <code> tags are removed but enclosed text is retained, indentation markers are removed, and whitespace is collapsed and trimmed. MediaWiki templates and external links are preserved to maintain fidelity to the original discussions. The same normalization was applied also to articles.
paragraphs.zh: Wiki-Talkie 中的所有用户名都通过带密钥的哈希函数和盐值进行确定性哈希处理以实现匿名化，从而确保数据集内映射的一致性，同时防止反向还原。 不仅结构化元数据中，就连评论文本中也识别并替换了用户名的出现情况；在评论中，编辑经常通过维基链接语法或纯文本引用来相互提及。13 13 13 有关用户重新识别相关的风险，请参见《伦理声明》部分。 随后对讨论串的格式进行清理和标准化：移除开头和结尾的装饰性字符（连字符、等号），将 HTML 换行符转换为换行符，剥离样式标签（<div>、<span>、<u>）但保留内容，移除 <nowiki> 和 <code> 标签但保留其内部文本，删除缩进标记，并合并与修剪空白字符。 保留了 MediaWiki 模板和外部链接，以忠实还原原始讨论内容。 同样的标准化处理也应用于文章。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 reports statistics of the sampled data from Wiki-Talkie. English and French are the largest splits, with roughly 9–10k comments each. German, despite starting from the same number of initial threads (5,000), yielded fewer turns after subsampling. Spanish and Italian are roughly half the size of English and French. Thread length is consistent across languages, averaging around 3 previous comments per turn. All languages exhibit a strong male skew in user distribution, consistent with the well-documented gender gap in Wikipedia editorship Cabrera et al. (2018) . The skew is most pronounced in Italian and Spanish, where the limited pool of female editors made gender balancing impossible. English and French are the most balanced: in the French split, for instance, male and female editors contribute nearly equal numbers of sentences despite a skewed ratio of unique users.

paragraphs.en: All next-turn generations were produced using a cloud-based batch inference service. Generations were conducted with a temperature of 0 0 to ensure deterministic outputs, and a maximum of 1,024 1{,}024 tokens were generated per response. To accommodate the context window constraints of each model, input prompts were dynamically truncated when necessary: if the combined length of the system and user prompts exceeded the available input budget (i.e., the model’s context window minus the reserved generation tokens), the article body was progressively shortened by iteratively reducing it to 90% of its current length until the prompt fit within the budget, with a <article_truncated> marker appended to signal the truncation. For the history method, if the full history caused the prompt to exceed the context window, the number of historical threads was progressively reduced until the prompt fit; instances where the resulting history fell below the minimum threshold of 5 5 threads were flagged as underrepresented. Prompts that could not be reduced to fit within the context window even after exhausting all truncation strategies were discarded.
paragraphs.zh: 所有下一轮的生成均通过基于云的批量推理服务完成。 生成过程采用 0.0 的温度值以确保输出具有确定性，且每次响应的最大生成令牌数为 1,024 个。 为适应各模型上下文窗口的限制，输入提示在必要时会被动态截断：若系统提示与用户提示的总长度超过可用输入配额（即模型的上下文窗口减去预留的生成令牌数），则文章正文会逐步缩短——通过反复将其长度缩减至当前长度的 90%，直至提示符合配额要求，并在末尾添加 <article_truncated> 标记以表明已截断。 对于历史方法，若完整的历史记录导致提示超出上下文窗口，则会逐步减少历史对话线程的数量，直至提示符合要求；若最终的历史记录少于 5 条对话线程的最小阈值，则会被标记为代表性不足。 即便穷尽所有截断策略仍无法缩短至符合上下文窗口的提示，均被舍弃。

paragraphs.en: To validate our LLM-based annotation approach, we rely on the SEWD dataset Ferschke et al. (2012) . SEWD provides act annotations for English Wikipedia talk page discussions, a setting analogous to Wiki-Talkie corpus. In SEWD, the reconciled labels of two trained annotators serve as the gold standard. We use these reconciled labels to evaluate the quality of our LLM-as-annotator pipeline (the extractor model). For clarity, we rename and merge some labels to reduce granularity; the full mapping is reported in Table 4 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了验证我们基于大型语言模型（LLM）的标注方法，我们依赖 Ferschke 等人（2012）提出的 SEWD 数据集。 SEWD 为英文维基百科讨论页面的讨论内容提供了行为标注，这一场景与 Wiki-Talkie 语料库类似。 在 SEWD 中，两名训练有素的标注员经过协调后的标签被用作黄金标准。 我们利用这些协调后的标签来评估以 LLM 作为标注员的流程（即提取模型）的质量。 为清晰起见，我们对部分标签进行了重命名和合并以降低其粒度；完整的对应关系见表 4。

paragraphs.en: However, the format of SEWD differs substantially from Wiki-Talkie. In SEWD, label spans are assigned directly to raw comments within a thread, without prior splitting or cleaning, whereas in our scenario we aim to provide the LLM with preceding comments as conversational context and a single target reply to be labelled. To bridge this gap, we first convert SEWD into the Wiki-Talkie format, structuring each instance as a target comment to be annotated along with its preceding comments as context, and aligning the corresponding SEWD labels. This conversion inevitably introduces noise; we therefore manually clean the resulting instances and discard those that could not be reliably mapped. From the original 1,500 threads in SEWD, this procedure yields 735 usable threads, which constitute our validation set.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，SEWD 的格式与 Wiki-Talkie 存在显著差异。 在 SEWD 中，标签跨度被直接分配给线程内的原始评论，无需事先分割或清理；而在我们的场景中，我们旨在为 LLM 提供作为对话上下文的前序评论，以及一个需要标注的单一目标回复。 为了弥合这一差距，我们首先将 SEWD 转换为 Wiki-Talkie 格式：将每个实例构造成一个待标注的目标评论，并附上其前序评论作为上下文，同时对齐相应的 SEWD 标签。 这种转换不可避免地会引入噪声；因此，我们对转换后的实例进行人工清理，并丢弃那些无法可靠映射的实例。 从 SEWD 最初的 1,500 个线程中，该流程最终得到了 735 个可用的线程，这些线程构成了我们的验证集。

paragraphs.en: Since replies in talk page discussions typically do not refer to much earlier context, we experiment with varying amounts of preceding conversational history: all previous comments, up to three, up to two, or only the immediately preceding comment. The prompt provided to the LLM includes explanations of each act label together with illustrative English examples drawn from SEWD. Table 5 reports the Micro-F1 and per-label F1 scores across these settings. Performance is stable across context windows, with the two-comment setting achieving the highest Micro-F1 (0.77). We therefore adopt this configuration for all subsequent annotation. Notably, these scores are very close to the human inter-annotator agreement reported in Ferschke et al., 2012 (Micro-F1 = 0.79), even though the two evaluation sets are not perfectly overlapping: ours is the product of format conversion and manual filtering, whereas the figure in Ferschke et al., 2012 results from cross-validation over the entire SEWD corpus. Nevertheless, this proximity strongly suggests that the LLM approximates human-level labeling quality.

paragraphs.en: Examining the per-label scores, the most challenging categories (F1 < < 0.70) are in order Partial , and Reference , Negative , Inform . To better understand these discrepancies, one of the authors of this paper manually inspected 20 instances per class where the LLM prediction and the ground truth disagreed. In more than half of the cases, the author judged the LLM label to be more appropriate than the gold label. paragraphs.en: Across all conditions, agent-generated comments are substantially longer than human comments. Human comments average approximately 48–78 words depending on the language ( de being the shortest at ∼ 48 {\sim}48 words and es the longest at ∼ 78 {\sim}78 ), while agent output consistently exceeds these figures, often by a wide margin. Notably, the history method yields the shortest agent comments across all models—for instance, Model A drops to ∼ 88 {\sim}88 words on average, its closest approximation to human length—suggesting that exposure to real interaction excerpts helps calibrate verbosity. Conversely, the behavior and profile methods tend to inflate output length, particularly for Model D and Model B. Interestingly, es also elicits slightly longer agent comments than other languages across all conditioning methods, mirroring the fact that human comments in es are themselves the longest.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有条件下，智能体生成的评论都比人类评论要长得多。 人类评论的平均字数因语言而异，约为 48–78 词（德语最短，约 48 {\sim}48 词；西班牙语最长，约 78 {\sim}78 词），而智能体的输出则始终超过这些数值，且差距往往很大。 值得注意的是，在所有模型中，“历史”方法生成的智能体评论最短——例如，模型 A 的平均字数降至约 88 {\sim}88 词，这是其最接近人类评论长度的结果——这表明接触真实的互动片段有助于调节冗长程度。 相反，“行为”和“个人资料”方法则倾向于增加输出长度，尤其是在模型 D 和模型 B 中。 有趣的是，在所有条件设置方法中，西班牙语也引发了比其他语言稍长的智能体评论，这与西班牙语的人类评论本身最长这一事实相呼应。

paragraphs.en: The act density ratio is consistently below 1.0 across all conditions, indicating that agent-generated comments are uniformly richer in communicative intents than their human counterparts. paragraphs.zh: 在所有条件下，行为密度比率均持续低于 1.0，这表明智能体生成的评论在交际意图方面比人类生成的评论更为丰富。 在行为方法下观察到的比率最低，此时智能体似乎在执行预设的行为特征，而这些特征包含大量规范性互动信息。 相比之下，当通过历史数据引入真实示例时，所有模型和语言中的平均比率均升至 0.7 以上（Model B 除外），这表明具体示例有助于使行为密度更接近人类水平。

paragraphs.en: A natural concern with our experimental design is that the comparison across conditioning methods may not be fully information-balanced: the history method receives 5–20 raw prior comments, whereas profile and behavior receive compressed summaries. Part of the gain observed under history could therefore reflect a larger context budget (i.e., information quantity ) rather than a strictly better form of persona representation, i.e., information type .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验设计存在一个自然的担忧：不同条件设置方法之间的比较可能并未完全实现信息平衡——历史方法获得了 5–20 条原始过往评论，而个人资料和行为方法获得的则是压缩后的摘要。 因此，在历史方法下观察到的部分增益可能反映了更大的上下文预算（即信息数量），而非严格意义上更优的人格表现方式（即信息类型）。

paragraphs.en: To probe this confound, we examine how performance varies with the amount of conditioning information provided. We focus this analysis on profile length, where the available token budget varies meaningfully across users (see Table 2 and Figure 7 ). For history , the analogous analysis would require comparing performance across different numbers of prior comments. However, the history sampler defaults to using up to 20 comments per user, and in practice the vast majority of conditioning pools fall in the 16–20 range; lower-comment buckets are too sparsely populated to support a meaningful comparison. We therefore restrict the analysis to profile length, which provides a well-distributed and interpretable proxy for input richness.
paragraphs.zh: 为了探究这一混淆因素，我们考察了性能如何随所提供条件信息的多少而变化。 我们将此分析聚焦于个人资料长度，因为可用令牌配额在不同用户之间存在显著差异（参见表 2 和图 7）。 对于历史数据而言，类似的分析需要比较不同数量的先前评论所带来的性能差异。 然而，历史采样器默认使用每个用户最多 20 条评论，而实际上绝大多数条件池都落在 16–20 的区间内；评论较少的类别样本量过少，无法支持有意义的比较。 因此，我们将分析限制在个人资料长度上，因为它能提供一个分布良好且易于解释的输入丰富度代理指标。

paragraphs.en: Across all 20 language–model pairs, none of the four metrics improves consistently as profile length grows. A pure context-budget account would predict a downward slope for JSD metrics (lower divergence = better alignment) and an upward slope for similarity metrics (higher = better) as more conditioning tokens are provided. ROUGE-L and rBERT are nearly horizontal in every configuration (within-pair ranges of at most 0.026 0.026 and 0.044 0.044 , respectively). Where the JSD metrics do move, they mostly move in the opposite direction: dialog act JSD rises for all four models in fr , mainly from the 151–200 bucket onward, and sentiment JSD rises with profile length for all four models in es , fr , and it . The few downward trends are small and confined to en and de : dialog act JSD for Model A in en decreases from 0.135 0.135 to 0.098 0.098 , and sentiment JSD decreases for some models in en and de , in en largely because of the sparse 1–50 bucket (under 3% of samples).

paragraphs.en: Taken together, these results provide evidence against an information-density explanation for our main results. Together with the observation reported in the main text—that profile degrades performance relative to base despite adding tokens—this analysis supports our interpretation that information type , not information quantity , drives the differences across conditioning methods. We acknowledge that this analysis does not fully isolate every possible confound (e.g., compression-induced loss of stylistic exemplars), and we discuss this further in the Limitations.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，这些结果为反对用信息密度来解释我们的主要研究结果提供了证据。 结合正文中提到的观察结果——即尽管增加了标记，但特征描述相较于基础模型表现更差——这一分析支持了我们的解读：正是信息类型，而非信息数量，导致了不同条件化方法之间的差异。 我们承认，这一分析并未完全排除所有可能的干扰因素（例如，压缩导致的风格范例损失），我们将在“局限性”部分对此作进一步讨论。

sents.zh: 结合正文中提到的观察结果——即尽管增加了标记，但特征描述相较于基础模型表现更差——这一分析支持了我们的解读：正是信息类型，而非信息数量，导致了不同条件化方法之间的差异。

sents.en: We acknowledge that this analysis does not fully isolate every possible confound (e.g., compression-induced loss of stylistic exemplars), and we discuss this further in the Limitations.

paragraphs.en: Because profiles and behavioral traits are produced automatically by an LLM and then used as the key conditioning signals for profile , behavior , and behavior+r , their quality directly affects the interpretation of downstream results. To complement the quantitative analyses in the main text, we conducted a manual audit of these representations along three dimensions: (i) relevance and faithfulness of generated profiles with respect to the source user pages, (ii) coherence between assigned behavioral traits and the supporting reasoning produced by the extractor model, and (iii) privacy preservation , i.e., whether sensitive information (real names, usernames, contacts) is leaked into the generated representations. We sampled 10 users per language (50 total) uniformly at random from the experimental subset and one of the authors inspected, for each user, the generated profile, all 8 behavioral traits with their reasoning, and the underlying user page.
paragraphs.zh: 由于个人资料和行为特征是由大型语言模型自动生成的，并随后用作个人资料、行为以及“行为+资料”的关键条件信号，因此其质量会直接影响下游结果的解读。 为了补充正文中的定量分析，我们对这些表示进行了人工审核，涵盖三个维度：(i) 生成的个人资料与源用户页面之间的相关性和忠实度；(ii) 所分配的行为特征与提取模型生成的支持性推理之间的一致性；以及 (iii) 隐私保护，即敏感信息（真实姓名、用户名、联系方式）是否泄露到生成的表示中。 我们从实验子集中以均匀随机的方式按语言抽取了 10 名用户（总计 50 名），其中一位作者检查了每位用户生成的个人资料、全部 8 个行为特征及其推理依据，以及对应的原始用户页面。

sents.en: We identified a small number of imprecisions, none of which substantially distort the persona:
sents.zh: 我们发现少量不精确之处，但没有任何一处会显著扭曲人物设定：

paragraphs.en: English: one numerical drift (“42 years” instead of “45 years”); one rounding error on edit count (“100,000” instead of “100,000k”);
paragraphs.zh: 一处数值偏差（“42年”而非“45年”）；一处编辑次数的四舍五入错误（“100,000”而非“100,000k”）；

paragraphs.en: French: one case where contributed-article information was omitted;
paragraphs.zh: 法语：一种贡献文章信息被省略的情况；

paragraphs.en: German: one case where the username was incorporated into the profile as if it were a separate entity, likely due to hallucination triggered by user page ambiguity;
paragraphs.zh: 一个案例中，用户名被整合到了个人资料中，仿佛它是一个独立的实体，这很可能是由用户页面的模糊性所引发的幻觉所致；

paragraphs.en: Italian: one ungrammatical fragment (“Ha adottato il giorno 16 luglio e il comune di Plesio”) reflecting parsing ambiguity in the user page.
paragraphs.zh: 意大利语中有一个不合语法的片段（“Ha adottato il giorno 16 luglio e il comune di Plesio”），反映了用户页面中的解析歧义。

paragraphs.en: We additionally observed that information from userboxes —small standardized templates that Wikipedia editors place on their user pages to declare interests, languages spoken, locations, or affiliations—is sometimes incorporated into the profile and sometimes ignored, with no clear pattern across languages. Moreover, we noticed that gender, when not explicitly self-declared, is typically inferred from gender-marked terms (especially in the four grammatical-gender languages: German, Spanish, French, and Italian) and, when available, from given names.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还观察到，来自用户框的信息——维基百科编辑在其用户页面上放置的小型标准化模板，用于声明兴趣、使用的语言、地理位置或所属团体——有时会被纳入个人资料，有时则被忽略，且不同语言间并无明显规律。 此外，我们注意到，当性别未被明确自我声明时，通常会通过带有性别标记的术语（尤其是在四种具有语法性别的语言中：德语、西班牙语、法语和意大利语）来推断，若有可用信息，也会根据名字进行推断。

paragraphs.en: For each of the 8 behavioral categories, we checked whether the assigned trait value is consistent with the accompanying reasoning. Out of 50 × 8 = 400 50\times 8=400 trait-reasoning pairs, in only 7 cases (across English, Spanish, and Italian) was the assigned label found to trace back to the provided reasoning. In most other cases, the reasoning explicitly cites concrete excerpts from the user’s comment history in support of the assigned trait, providing transparent grounding for the conditioning signal.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 8 个行为类别中的每一个，我们都检查了所分配的特质值是否与相应的推理一致。 在 50 × 8 = 400 个特质-推理配对中，仅有 7 种情况（涵盖英语、西班牙语和意大利语）发现所分配的标签可以追溯到所提供的推理。 在大多数其他情况下，推理明确引用了用户评论历史中的具体片段来支持所分配的特质，从而为条件信号提供了透明的依据。

paragraphs.en: The audit surfaced two cases that warrant explicit mention:
paragraphs.zh: 此次审计发现了两起需要明确提及的案例：

paragraphs.en: one English profile mentioning a middle name, which the user themselves had self-disclosed anecdotally on their user page;
paragraphs.zh: 一份英文个人资料中提到了一个中间名，而用户本人曾在其用户页面上以个人经历的形式主动披露过该信息；

paragraphs.en: one German profile reproducing the username as if it were a separate named entity (the same hallucination case noted above).
paragraphs.zh: 一个德国个人资料将用户名重复呈现，仿佛它是一个独立的命名实体（即上文提到的同一种幻觉情况）。

paragraphs.en: No real legal names, contact details, or other directly identifying information were leaked into the generated representations.
paragraphs.zh: 生成的表示中未泄露任何真实的法律名称、联系方式或其他可直接识别的信息。

paragraphs.en: The audit indicates that the generated profiles and behavioral traits are largely faithful and well-grounded, with imprecisions concentrated at the level of isolated factual details rather than systematic distortions. This argues against an interpretation in which the relatively weak performance of profile and behavior is driven primarily by representation quality. At the same time, the audit highlights that profiles vary substantially in the kinds of information they emphasize (e.g., uneven uptake of userbox content) and that the compression step inherent in summarization may lose stylistic exemplars present in the raw history signal. In this sense, our results should be read as conclusions about the conditioning representations as we generated them , rather than as universal statements about all possible sociodemographic descriptors. We acknowledge this scope explicitly in the Limitations.
paragraphs.zh: 审计表明，生成的用户画像和行为特征在很大程度上是忠实且依据充分的，其不精确之处主要集中在孤立的事实细节层面，而非系统性的扭曲。 这一结果反驳了这样一种解释：即用户画像和行为表现相对较弱，主要是由表征质量所致。 同时，审计还指出，不同用户画像在强调的信息类型上存在显著差异（例如，对用户框内容吸收程度不均衡），并且摘要过程中固有的压缩步骤可能会丢失原始历史信号中存在的风格化范例。 从这个意义上说，我们的结果应被理解为对我们所生成条件化表征的结论，而非关于所有可能社会人口学描述符的普遍性陈述。 我们在“局限性”部分明确承认了这一研究范围的限制。
